title: Prove governed semantic and LLM authoring

verificationRecords.notes: Schema accepts only verified semantic references, registered operation/correspondence/focus/cadence/normal-form/compression intent, and rejects presentation or raw math authority.
Four compiler acceptance, repair, provenance, and unsafe-authority tests passed.
Three tests prove fixture grounding, deterministic compiler-owned policy, immutable provenance, and exclusion of presentation or unchecked math authority.
Application, Node, test, and domain TypeScript boundaries passed.
Full architecture and deterministic regression suite passed with the governed exemplar.
Production build and its repository typecheck passed.
Shared reader conformance cohort passed without route, URL-state, responsive, or accessibility regression.

progress.summary: One Codex-authored fraction fan-out response compiles only through verified source identities and exact operation contracts. Full gates pass and the bounded authority split is packaged for mandatory human review.

expectedLearning: Whether an LLM can select verified semantics, correspondence, focus, cadence, and normal-form intent while deterministic compilers retain geometry, timing, typography, responsive adaptation, rendering, validation, and repair authority.
allowedWork: Add a constrained semantic authoring schema, deterministic compiler and rejection paths, provenance, repair diagnostics, and one governed exemplar workflow.
disallowedWork: Do not allow LLM-authored DOM, CSS, pixels, arbitrary keyframes, unchecked mathematical claims, or direct mutation outside verified contracts.
